summary: Arcane Power with four Arcane Blast stacks every 15s (60% of Intellect as spell damage) and a Frostbolt filler, on the Arcane gear (Gloves - Arcane Power).
rotation: Pre-pull: Arcane Blast at -1.5s so it lands at the pull
Arcane Power and Presence of Mind with the on-use trinket (unless it won't be back in time); other cooldowns on a free GCD; mana gems never
Fire Blast, then Arcane Explosion, when a Frostbolt would not land before the end (its cast plus 0.75s)
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc, ahead of the Arcane Blasts
Below 20% mana: one Arcane Blast per 15s buff
Arcane Blast to 4 stacks (each 15% of Intellect as spell damage for 15s from the first)
Shoot the wand when nothing else can be cast (out of mana)
consumes: Scroll of Imbue Precision (staff imbue, on top of the oil)
caveats: Open: when Arcane Blast stacks land and whether more stacks refresh the 15s.
Assumed: Arcane Concentration on missile ticks, with a 1s internal cooldown.
Arcane Mind's crit behavior is assumed.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Fireball XI, Frostbolt X, Arcane Missiles VII). With the books: Frost +50, Arcane +30, Fire +17, Frostfire 0.
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_arcane unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring). It carries the spec's staff imbue scroll (Scroll of Imbue Precision) as a mage option, as the preset does.
